payload.message: Gere um relatório matinal conciso em português para o Douglas. Execute CADA comando abaixo e inclua os resultados: 1) uptime 2) df -h / 3) memory_pressure 4) docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}" 5) ollama ps 6) tail -5 ~/.openclaw/logs/openclaw.log 7) source ~/.zshrc 2>/dev/null; bash -x ~/server/scripts/api-spending.sh daily — IMPORTANTE: O comando 7 DEVE ser executado via bash tool, nao invente o resultado. Mostre o output do comando 7 completo sem alterar. Formato final: mensagem curta com emojis para status. Resuma containers (diga quantos rodando). Destaque erros. Nao use markdown pesado.
Rode: bash ~/server/scripts/api-spending.sh daily — Copie o output EXATAMENTE como saiu do terminal, sem alterar, omitir ou reformatar nada. Envie o texto completo.
Rode: bash ~/server/scripts/api-spending.sh weekly — Copie o output EXATAMENTE como saiu do terminal, sem alterar, omitir ou reformatar nada. Envie o texto completo.

Voce esta executando o DAILY REVIEW das 20:30. Siga as instrucoes do AGENTS.md secao 'Daily Review'. Passos: 1) Leia PROTOCOLO_ANUAL_2026.md e identifique metas do ciclo atual. 2) Colete TODOS os registros de hoje da memoria (refeicoes, treino, peso, dor, TRT). 3) Se nao houver registros, informe que nao ha dados para revisar hoje. 4) Monte o resumo comparativo (realizado vs planejado). 5) Apresente formatado e pergunte se Doug aprova para persistir no banco.

Siga estes passos EXATAMENTE na ordem:

PASSO 1 — Coletar feeds:
```bash
cd ~/.openclaw/skills/ai-daily-digest && python3 scripts/fetch_miniflux.py
```
Se falhar conexão com Miniflux, use: `python3 scripts/collect_feeds.py`

PASSO 2 — Ler o perfil:
```bash
cat ~/.openclaw/skills/ai-daily-digest/references/user-profile.md
```

PASSO 3 — Gerar digest:
Com base nos itens do PASSO 1 e perfil do PASSO 2, gere o digest em português:
- Organize em seções: 🔧 Ferramentas que uso, 🧠 Novos modelos, 🛠 Open-source/Self-hosted, 🔥 Tendências
- Máximo 15 itens, cada um com título (link) e 1-2 frases de relevância
- ⚡ para breaking news (novo modelo Claude, mudança Cursor)
- Omita seções vazias
- Finalize com 💡 Dica do dia
- Header: 📰 AI Daily Digest — DD/MM/YYYY

PASSO 4 — Marcar como lidos:
```bash
cd ~/.openclaw/skills/ai-daily-digest && cat data/last_entry_ids.json | python3 scripts/fetch_miniflux.py --mark-read
```

IMPORTANTE: O resultado final (PASSO 3) é a mensagem que será entregue ao usuário.

It's time for the morning wake-up ping. Read your SOUL.md, MEMORY.md and today's memory log. Check due vocabulary with english-srs. Then send a wake-up message following the template in AGENTS.md. Keep it short and engaging. IMPORTANT: Just output the message text directly. Do NOT try to send it via Telegram or any tool — the delivery system handles that automatically.

It's lunchtime micro-dose. Read today's memory log to see what errors were made this morning. Send a short exercise (1 sentence to complete or translate) based on morning errors. Follow the micro-dose template in AGENTS.md. Keep it very brief. IMPORTANT: Just output the message text directly. Do NOT try to send it via Telegram or any tool — the delivery system handles that automatically.

Evening micro-dose time. Send a casual small talk question about how Douglas's day was. Follow the evening micro-dose template in AGENTS.md. One question, keep it natural and brief. IMPORTANT: Just output the message text directly. Do NOT try to send it via Telegram or any tool — the delivery system handles that automatically.

Daily vocabulary time. Read MEMORY.md for current curriculum week and level. Pick 3 new words relevant to the current week's topic from the 6-month curriculum. Follow the Daily Vocab template in AGENTS.md. Words should be tech-context focused. IMPORTANT: Just output the message text directly. Do NOT try to send it via Telegram or any tool — the delivery system handles that automatically.

Weekend casual mode! Share something interesting in English — a tech topic, article, cultural discussion, gaming, music. Follow the Weekend Casual template in AGENTS.md. Keep it fun and light, but still in English. IMPORTANT: Just output the message text directly. Do NOT try to send it via Telegram or any tool — the delivery system handles that automatically.

Voce esta executando o MORNING BRIEF das 8h. Execute os passos:
1. Leia SOUL.md e USER.md
2. Execute: python3 ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/tiktok-db/scripts/manage_plan.py '{"action": "get_today_tasks"}'
3. Execute: python3 ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/tiktok-db/scripts/query_performance.py '{"type": "summary", "days": 1}'
4. Execute: python3 ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/tiktok-db/scripts/query_learnings.py '{"min_confidence": 0.6}'
5. Monte o plano do dia com: tarefas da fase atual + metricas de ontem + dica baseada em learnings
6. Formato: emojis, curto, direto. Sem markdown pesado.

Voce esta executando o EVENING CHECK das 21h. Execute os passos:
1. Execute: python3 ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/tiktok-db/scripts/manage_plan.py '{"action": "get_today_tasks"}'
2. Execute: python3 ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/tiktok-db/scripts/query_performance.py '{"type": "summary", "days": 1}'
3. Liste tarefas completadas (completed=true) e nao completadas
4. Mostre vendas do dia se houver
5. Pergunte se quer registrar metricas de algum video
6. Formato: recap curto com emojis. Use checkmarks para completadas, X para pendentes.

Voce esta executando o WEEKLY REVIEW de domingo. Execute:
1. Execute: bash ~/.openclaw/workspaces/tiktok-coach/skills/strategy-review/scripts/run_review.sh
2. Apresente o resultado completo da analise
3. Se houver novos learnings sugeridos, registre-os no banco com:
   python3 -c "import subprocess,json; [subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-e','PGPASSWORD=...',  'postgres','psql','-U','tiktok_coach','-d','tiktok_coach','-c',f\"INSERT INTO learnings (category, insight, confidence) VALUES ('{c}','{i}',{conf});\"], capture_output=True) for c,i,conf in learnings]"
   Ou use docker exec diretamente para cada INSERT
4. Se houver ajustes no plano, atualize via manage_plan.py
5. Formato: completo mas organizado. Pode ser mais longo que mensagens normais.
